name: MicroFactory: Echoes of the Seed
detailed_description:
Your team is stranded after a catastrophic crash on a mysterious island. But don’t worry about desperate survival tactics here — this is a calm, captivating journey of creation and discovery. It’s a factory-building game with a narrative focus, inviting you to build a thriving future from practically nothing.

You’ll begin by crafting the most basic tools and structures by hand, then steadily advance through technological eras. Your ultimate goal is to design highly efficient factories — evolving from simple wood and stone production to complex automated systems, robust electricity, and advanced industrial machinery. Forget pressing threats or tight deadlines; here, it’s all about the deep satisfaction of building and optimizing while soaking in the atmosphere.

The island is overflowing with secrets. While wandering among its beautiful landscapes, you'll come across ancient remnants of history alongside puzzling fragments that will slowly tell the world's hidden story. These findings not only shape the adventure but also impact the development of the team, to some extent changing the emotional depth of the journey.

Forget about fighting, starvation, or extreme weather conditions. This is a peaceful, meditative expedition driven by the intricacies of human life.

short_description: After an accident, you and your team become stranded on an island. With only sticks and stones, you'll build and automate. As your factories expand, you begin to uncover strange traces of the past. Secrets this island has kept hidden for far longer than anyone ever imagined.
